title: My Soul Thirsts for You

questions.question: O God, you are my God; earnestly I seek you; my soul thirsts for whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 63:1 (ESV): "O God, you are my God; earnestly I seek you; my soul thirsts for you;"

questions.question: My flesh faints for you, as in a dry and weary land where there is no what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 63:1 (ESV): "...as in a dry and weary land where there is no water."

questions.question: Because your steadfast love is better than life, my lips will do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 63:3 (ESV): "Because your steadfast love is better than life, my lips will praise you."

questions.question: So I will bless you as long as I live; in your name I will lift up my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 63:4 (ESV): "So I will bless you as long as I live; in your name I will lift up my hands."

questions.question: My soul will be satisfied as with fat and rich food, and my mouth will praise you with joyful what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 63:5 (ESV): "...and my mouth will praise you with joyful lips,"

questions.question: When I remember you upon my bed, and meditate on you in the watches of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 63:6 (ESV): "...and meditate on you in the watches of the night;"

questions.question: For you have been my help, and in the shadow of your wings I will sing for what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 63:7 (ESV): "...and in the shadow of your wings I will sing for joy."

questions.question: My soul clings to you; your right hand does what to me?
questions.explanation: Psalm 63:8 (ESV): "My soul clings to you; your right hand upholds me."

questions.question: But those who seek to destroy my life shall go down into the depths of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 63:9 (ESV): "But those who seek to destroy my life shall go down into the depths of the earth;"

questions.question: They shall be given over to the power of the sword; they shall be a portion for whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 63:10 (ESV): "...they shall be a portion for jackals."

questions.question: But the king shall rejoice in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 63:11 (ESV): "But the king shall rejoice in God;"

questions.question: All who swear by him shall exult, for the mouths of whom shall be stopped?
questions.explanation: Psalm 63:11 (ESV): "...for the mouths of liars shall be stopped."

questions.question: This Psalm was written when David was where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 63 Title: "A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah."

questions.question: So I have looked upon you in the sanctuary, beholding your power and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 63:2 (ESV): "So I have looked upon you in the sanctuary, beholding your power and glory."

key_verse_text: Because your steadfast love is better than life, my lips will praise you.
